{{Quote|We stationed guards, but...|Unidentified male lieutenant, before being killed by Darth Vader|<ref name="Trapped" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' with the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] was stationed at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Belazura's Imperial garrison|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belazura]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the lieutenant was ordered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to detain [[Rezi Soresh]], the highest commanding officer on the planet. But Soresh was able to escape using a hidden [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] on his quarters. When Vader arrived, he held the lieutenant responsible for Soresh's escape, and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|strangled]] him to [[Death/Legends|death]] using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Trapped" />
